note: Outside the stated ICP on four of five criteria, and the highest-intent prospect in the batch. Successful is a miss as written — a facilities manager overseeing maintenance of a school district headquarters building is not the business owner, physician or equivalent the ICP names; he started work at fourteen to help support his family and is three to four years from retirement. Income is a hard miss with specifics attached: a household rule requiring joint discussion above $1,000, a house purchase in progress, and a history of serious debt cleared through a structured programme. Neglected_health is a miss, though not in the usual direction — health is not neglected here, it is the thing he is fighting hardest, with 25 lb lost since September, 22-hour daily fasting since February, seven miles of hiking a week and a Mount Whitney summit. What he has is a crisis he is already mid-way through addressing, which fails the criterion on severity in the opposite sense from the intended one. Good_to_great is a clear miss: four active injury sites, sciatica resolved three weeks ago, and a man who cannot perform a burpee or a push-up is a rescue case, not an upgrade. Not_deconditioned is scored a match on a careful reading — the criterion is conjunctive, excluding people who are fifty pounds overweight AND gym-averse, and while he sits near the weight boundary at 175 lb and 5'5" with his own 'I'm still overweight, I totally have a dad bod', he is the least gym-averse person in this folder. THE FINDING, and it points the opposite way from the Andreas Xagoraris call on the same day: the prospect who scores lowest against the stated ICP rated his need a 10 out of 10, and the prospect who scores highest was disqualified. Across this batch the correlation between stated-ICP fit and buying intent is not merely weak, it is inverted. That is a stronger version of the observation already recorded in icp.json that the buying population is wider than the stated ICP, and it deserves testing at corpus scale before the ICP is used to filter lead flow.
